jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (sometimes three shifts) and weekends
• Team-oriented and communicative
• Accurate and safety-conscious
• Proactive and solution-oriented

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

Driven by a team of skilled machining specialists and continuous investment in automation and state-of-the-art machinery, De Beleyr Engineering guarantees high delivery reliability, short lead times, and top-tier craftsmanship.

 Required Experience:

• Ability to work with high accuracy, control, and patience to bring workpieces step-by-step to the exact size.

• Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems independently.

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

jobs.occupation: Experienced Wheel Loader Operator Wanted for Recycling Site in Sint-Katelijne-Waver
jobs.description:
For our client, a leading recycling company in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, I am looking for an experienced wheel loader operator. You play a crucial role in keeping the material flow around our fixed crushing installation running smoothly. You actively work with the team and support daily operations wherever needed.

On an average day, you operate the wheel loader to move, sort, and stockpile rubble and recycled aggregates. You supply the crushing installation and assist with loading and unloading trucks. Operating a forklift is also part of your tasks, as well as carrying out daily inspections and basic maintenance of the machines. You promptly report technical issues and ensure the workplace remains safe and tidy, even in dusty conditions.

Does this hands-on, varied position appeal to you? Apply soon – I am happy to tell you more about this great opportunity.

• Valid wheel loader license (required by Belgian regulations)

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a wheel loader operator

• Willingness to operate a forklift (license is a plus)

• Good command of English (spoken and written)

• Able to work independently and reliably

• Hands-on mentality and flexible

• Punctual, communicative, and in good physical condition

• Willing to work in a dusty, outdoor industrial environment

Step into an exciting role as a Folding Machine Operator - this is your chance to work with a team committed to crafting the future of the printing industry, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense approach.Your day will involve setting up and operating folding machines like the Heidelberg Stahlfolder, ensuring that all materials meet quality standards. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

As a Maintenance Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently on our production lines. Step into a role that molds the very foundation of tomorrow's structures. As a Concrete Worker, you play a crucial role in preparing, placing, and finishing concrete for various structural projects. Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:

You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience
